name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind

source.note: One of the three Tarokka treasures (data/tarokka). Properties paraphrased from the adventure in our own words; every number must be checked against the book when the mechanics are built (Phase 5).

magic.attunement: a Cleric or Paladin of good heart

summary: A platinum sunburst with a raven in flight at its heart and a sunstone in the raven's grip. It is warm to hold, even here.
text: A holy symbol made long ago by the faithful who fought the valley's first vampire, and lost when its last keeper never came home. It holds 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 of them each dawn. While holding it, its attuned bearer can spend charges: Hold Vampires (1 charge): every vampire and vampire spawn within 30 feet that can see the symbol makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or is Paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Sunlight (5 charges): the sunstone blazes with true sunlight, bright in a 30-foot radius and dim for 30 feet beyond, for 10 minutes. The bearer's Turn Undead also bites harder while the symbol is raised: undead make their saving throws against it at a disadvantage.
